Js13kGames 2023, 4th place. Source is Vite ESM + kontra. GifOS drops
type=module, and the packed dist/index.html is a Roadroller eval blob, so
vendor/game.js is an esbuild IIFE of src/main.js + kontra@9.0.0:

  npx esbuild@0.21.5 src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2017

localStorage is stubbed by shim.js (the sandbox has none); boot.js
hydrates gifos.db into that stub before this file runs. Highscore,
sound, and grid-lock keys ('Tiny Yurts', 'Tiny Yurtss', 'Tiny Yurtsg')
are the same as upstream.

Phone patch in this IIFE (keep when re-bundling): isDraw() treats a
primary touch as a left-drag, setPointerCapture on pointerdown, clientX
instead of event.x. Portrait fit lives in boot.js. TinyYurts is exported
for the unit suite.

kontra.js is MIT (Steven Lambert) — COPYING-kontra.txt.
